items.condition: Substituting the old arbitrary (10,10) tube as experimental identity, deleting octyl substituents silently, confusing vacuum energy references or equating a HOMO level with measured charge transfer invalidates dependent claims.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A HOMO comparison alone does not prove charge transfer, doping type, mobility, conductivity, Seebeck coefficient or power factor. A chosen nanotube chirality is not the experimental sample. Do not claim film or device performance from an unsupported local model.
